items.title: Gradium opens a new TTS beta: gradium-tts-beta-202611
items.summary: Gradium's release notes (2026.11.24) announce a new text-to-speech model in beta, selectable via model_name gradium-tts-beta-202611 or the Studio Model dropdown. Default and the gradium-tts-beta alias stay on the production model.
items.whyItMatters: Gradium targets low-latency voice-agent TTS; worth an A/B listen for French naturalness and latency as an alternative to Anna's ElevenLabs voice.
